vocabulary.meaning_en: a story people pass around that may not be true
vocabulary.example: There's a rumour that the office is moving.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to tell rumours to many people
vocabulary.example: Please don't spread rumours about your colleagues.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to tell information to another person
vocabulary.example: Please don't pass the rumours on.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (of a story or illness) to move from person to person
vocabulary.example: There's a story going around about job cuts.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to pay no attention to something
vocabulary.example: Ignore the rumours and keep working.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to find out what is really true
vocabulary.example: First, we need to establish the facts.

vocabulary.meaning_en: immediately
vocabulary.example: I'll call you straight away.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to continue
vocabulary.example: Please carry on with your work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in the usual way
vocabulary.example: The shop will open as normal tomorrow.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to come and stand close together in a group
vocabulary.example: Could everyone gather round, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: when a company reduces the number of workers
vocabulary.example: The company announced job cuts.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (informal) to dismiss someone from their job
vocabulary.note_ar: رسميًا: dismiss. وتعبير get the sack = يُطرد.
vocabulary.example: He was sacked for being late every day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to feel sudden fear and not think clearly
vocabulary.example: Don't panic – the news is not true.

vocabulary.meaning_en: without other people listening
vocabulary.example: Can I speak to you in private?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to disturb or interrupt someone
vocabulary.example: Sorry to bother you, but the printer isn't working.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large formal meeting for many people from an industry
vocabulary.example: She is speaking at a conference in Dubai.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a prize given for doing something well
vocabulary.example: Our team won an award for the best design.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the last stage of a competition; last
vocabulary.example: We're in the final for the best product award.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short talk you give when you receive a prize
vocabulary.example: He thanked his team in his acceptance speech.

vocabulary.meaning_en: needing to be done immediately
vocabulary.example: This is urgent – please reply today.

vocabulary.word: have a lot on your plate
vocabulary.meaning_en: to be very busy with many things to do
vocabulary.example: I can't help this week; I have a lot on my plate.

vocabulary.meaning_en: I will keep it secret
vocabulary.example: Don't worry, mum's the word.

vocabulary.meaning_en: speak more quietly
vocabulary.example: Keep your voice down – people are working.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to try to do something
vocabulary.example: I've never written a speech, but I'll give it a go.

fine_lines.title: carry on vs keep on
fine_lines.explanation_ar: carry on تعني استمر أو واصل، وتأتي غالبًا مع with + اسم. keep on + فعل بـ ing تعني الاستمرار في فعل الشيء مرارًا، وأحيانًا بطريقة مزعجة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Carry on (with)' means continue. 'Keep on + -ing' means continue doing something, often again and again.

examples.sentence: Please carry on with your work as normal.
He keeps on asking the same question.

fine_lines.title: straight away vs soon
fine_lines.explanation_ar: straight away تعني فورًا بلا تأخير. soon تعني بعد وقت قصير، وليس بالضرورة الآن.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Straight away' means immediately. 'Soon' means after a short time.

examples.sentence: I will let you know straight away.
The results will be ready soon.

expressions.phrase: There are some rumours going around that are not true.
expressions.meaning_ar: هناك بعض الإشاعات المنتشرة وهي غير صحيحة.
expressions.meaning_en: Some stories people are telling are false.
expressions.example: There are some rumours going around that are not true. The office is not closing.

expressions.meaning_ar: من فضلكم لا تستمعوا إلى الإشاعات.
expressions.meaning_en: Do not believe stories that are not confirmed.
expressions.example: Please don't listen to rumours about the new manager.

expressions.phrase: I am trying to establish the facts and if I get any information I will let you know straight away.
expressions.meaning_ar: أحاول التحقق من الحقائق، وإذا حصلت على أي معلومات فسأخبركم فورًا.
expressions.meaning_en: I'm finding out what's true and will tell you immediately.
expressions.example: I am trying to establish the facts. If I get any information, I will let you know straight away.

expressions.phrase: Ignore the rumours and please don't pass them on.
expressions.meaning_ar: تجاهلوا الإشاعات ومن فضلكم لا تنقلوها لغيركم.
expressions.meaning_en: Don't believe the stories and don't tell others.
expressions.example: Ignore the rumours and please don't pass them on to customers.

expressions.phrase: Please just carry on with your work as normal. Thank you.
expressions.meaning_ar: من فضلكم واصلوا عملكم كالمعتاد. شكرًا لكم.
expressions.meaning_en: Continue working in the usual way.
expressions.example: Please just carry on with your work as normal. Thank you.

expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكن للجميع أن يتجمعوا هنا من فضلكم؟
expressions.meaning_en: Please come and stand together near me.
expressions.example: Could everyone gather round, please? I have an announcement.
Sorry to bother you, but do you have a minute?

expressions.phrase: I've got quite a lot on my plate.
expressions.example: I'd love to help, but I've got quite a lot on my plate this week.

grammar.title: Negative imperatives with please
grammar.explanation_ar: لطلب عدم فعل شيء بأدب نستخدم Please + don't + الفعل الأساسي. وللأمر الإيجابي المهذب: Please + الفعل.
grammar.explanation_en: For polite negative instructions use Please don't + base verb. For positive ones use Please + base verb.
examples: Please carry on with your work.

grammar.title: First conditional: if + present, will + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: If + المضارع البسيط، ثم will + الفعل للحديث عن نتيجة ممكنة في المستقبل. لا نستخدم will بعد if.
grammar.explanation_en: If + present simple, will + base verb, for a likely future result. Don't use 'will' after 'if'.
examples: If I get any information, I will let you know.
If the boss calls, I'll tell you.
If we win, we will celebrate.

grammar.title: There is / There are + -ing / that clause
grammar.explanation_ar: There are some rumours going around = هناك إشاعات تنتشر. نستخدم there is مع المفرد و there are مع الجمع.
grammar.explanation_en: Use 'there is' with singular and 'there are' with plural nouns to say something exists. You can add an -ing phrase after the noun: There are some rumours going around.
examples: There are some rumours going around.
There is an award for the best product.
There are ten people in the meeting.

questions.question: What is a 'rumour'?
choices: a story people pass around that may not be true
questions.explanation_ar: rumour إشاعة قد لا تكون صحيحة.
questions.explanation_en: A rumour is a story that may not be true.

questions.question: Ignore the rumours and please don't ___ them on.
If I get any information, I ___ you know straight away.
questions.explanation_ar: الشرط الأول: if + مضارع، will + فعل.

questions.question: Please just ___ with your work as normal.
What does 'I've got a lot on my plate' mean?
Anna asks everyone to 'gather round'. She wants them to ___.
choices: come and stand together near her
questions.explanation_en: It means come together in a group.

questions.question: 'Establish the facts' means ___.
choices: find out what is really true
questions.explanation_ar: establish the facts = التحقق من الحقيقة.
questions.explanation_en: It means find out what is true.

questions.question: What is an 'acceptance speech'?
choices: a talk you give when you get a job
a talk you give when you receive a prize
questions.explanation_ar: acceptance speech كلمة تُلقى عند استلام جائزة.
questions.explanation_en: It's a talk given when you receive an award.
